scope: Exact r4 images; independent per-CVE primary-source and bounded code/runtime reachability review. not_affected is conditional engineering inference under the declared product inputs/deployment, never a native patch claim. No exploit is run against host or production data.
reviewInvalidation: Different image digest/package version or new CVE
Changes to input limits, DTD guard or pinned-template verification

rows.precondition: Privileged mount with a user/users fstab target whose ancestor is attacker-writable.
rows.justification: The exact images have no fstab entries. Declared execution is UID1000, read-only root, CapEff=0 and NoNewPrivs=1; no privileged mount caller or product mount endpoint exists. This excludes the required privileged fstab mount, not the presence of the installed util-linux package.

rows.precondition: A failed privileged external mount helper followed by X-mount owner/idmap hooks.
rows.justification: No fstab X-mount configuration exists; product processes do not invoke mount helpers. UID1000 with all capabilities dropped and no-new-privileges cannot gain the privileged post-hook authority. Re-evaluate if privileged mounts or fstab entries are added.

rows.precondition: A root nsenter --join-cgroup caller enters an attacker-controlled target and leaks its privileged descriptor.
rows.justification: No product or startup command invokes nsenter. The deployment uses a private PID namespace, no host cgroup mount and UID1000 with no capabilities; a privileged host operator running nsenter is outside this container workflow. The required root-created descriptor is absent.

rows.precondition: An authorized X-mount.subdir fstab mount and attacker-controlled intermediate symlink.
rows.justification: The inspected fstab is empty and read-only; no X-mount.subdir operation is supplied by the product. UID1000/CapEff0/NoNewPrivs1 prohibit the privileged mount operation. Kernel version alone is not used to dismiss this CVE.

rows.precondition: A restricted privileged bind mount from fstab followed by X-mount owner/group/mode changes.
rows.justification: No fstab bind-mount authorization or X-mount hooks exist in the inspected runtime. Product subprocesses are fixed Python/LibreOffice/PostgreSQL tools, never mount; all capabilities are dropped and privilege gains disabled.

rows.precondition: Expat processes DTD ATTLIST declarations and many non-normalized attribute values.
rows.justification: The actual upload path now parses all OOXML XML/rels with a DOCTYPE-start rejection before the internal subset or attribute normalization. Six exact-image regressions cover the upstream shape,100000 attributes, UTF16/chunk boundaries, metadata/rels and valid workbooks. This removes the input precondition; native Expat remains unpatched. Pinned DOCX templates are not uploaded by users.

rows.precondition: Malformed D-Bus introspection XML reaches g_dbus_node_info_new_for_xml.
rows.justification: ELF inspection locates direct calls only in the optional GTK3 GUI plugins, not the headless libmergedlo entrypoint. No D-Bus socket/address/DISPLAY is configured and uploaded XML goes to openpyxl, not D-Bus introspection. The missing input channel, rather than GLib package absence, is the basis.

rows.precondition: Malformed serialized GVariant tuple data reaches normal-form validation.
rows.justification: libmergedlo creates/reads GVariants for D-Bus proxy calls; there is no D-Bus peer in the declared container. GSettings/system metadata are immutable image files; the product has no raw GVariant or settings upload API. ELF imports of GVariant in libgio are retained in evidence, not denied. Reassess if a host bus or user settings directory is mounted.

rows.precondition: An invalid object from g_date_time_add_full is consumed by g_date_time_get_ymd.
rows.justification: Neither the LibreOffice plugins nor the inspected transitive dependencies import g_date_time_add_full. Product dates are strict calendar strings inserted as XML text, not GDateTime arithmetic programs; no user-controlled GLib date arithmetic operation is exposed.

rows.precondition: g_regex_replace combines G_REGEX_RAW with case-changing escapes and invalid UTF8.
rows.justification: No LibreOffice module imports g_regex_replace; libgio imports the literal variant, which does not interpret case-change replacement escapes. Product values are Unicode JSON/XML text; arbitrary raw-byte GLib regex programs are not accepted.

rows.precondition: GIO line reading uses a custom terminator longer than one byte.
rows.justification: No inspected LibreOffice or transitive dependency imports g_io_channel_set_line_term. libgio line-reader presence is acknowledged, but the custom-terminator setter/input required by this CVE is not exposed by the product. File-content import is Python/openpyxl, not configurable GIO channels.

rows.precondition: g_key_file_get_locale_string_list reads an attacker-controlled key file value.
rows.justification: libgio imports the function, but applicable desktop/GSettings key files remain read-only image metadata. User uploads are private image/CSV/XLSX files and no XDG configuration, desktop file or arbitrary filesystem destination is accepted. This conditional exclusion becomes invalid if mutable user settings directories or desktop imports are introduced.

rows.precondition: A malicious reachable D-Bus server supplies DBUS_COOKIE_SHA1 cookie_context.

rows.precondition: libxml2 versions2.9.11–2.11.0 parse a crafted internal subset.
rows.justification: The actual XML bindings used by LibreOffice and lxml are2.14.6, outside the affected range. The separately installed system2.9.14 is not the renderer binding, and untrusted XLSX DTDs are rejected before lxml parsing.

rows.precondition: The upstream libxml2 Python SAX binding processes a DTD enumerated attribute declaration.
rows.justification: The upstream libxml2 Python binding is absent (import probe and filesystem search); lxml is a different binding. In addition the upload path rejects DTDs before downstream XML parsing.

rows.precondition: QName prefix/name lengths or dictionary pool growth overflow unsigned/size calculations.
rows.justification: The primary patch identifies overflow in4*(namelen+plen+1). Untrusted XLSX is capped at30MiB expanded XML with DTD expansion rejected; that cannot supply the approximately1GiB length required for the multiplication overflow. Generated DOCX QName names come only from hash-pinned templates; form values become text nodes, not names.

rows.precondition: xmlURIEscapeStr receives a string exceeding INT_MAX.
rows.justification: The primary patch checks xmlStrlen returning0 for lengths above INT_MAX. The entire accepted XLSX expansion is30MiB and API JSON2MiB; generated relation URIs are fixed/local template resources. There is no arbitrary multi-gigabyte URI construction or external resource URL input.

rows.precondition: DTD content-model validation diagnostics call xmlSnprintfElements.
rows.justification: All untrusted XLSX DTDs are rejected by xml_input.py. openpyxl/renderer do not request DTD validation; DOCX input is a pinned template and generated content has no attacker-controlled DTD. Merely parsing XML does not invoke this validation diagnostic.

rows.precondition: An application evaluates an attacker-controlled XPointer expression.
rows.justification: No XPointer or XInclude evaluation is called by renderer/openpyxl. The XPath expressions in rendering are fixed literals, distinct from XPointer processing. XLSX values never become XPath/XPointer programs; DOCX relationships are pinned/local.

rows.precondition: An output callback receives a single buffered XML length at least INT_MAX.
rows.justification: The primary patch checks >=INT_MAX output buffers. DOCX jobs render one bounded recipient against a pinned template; direct batch renderer caps100 and images remain separate ZIP binary parts. XLSX export serializes bounded scalar cells incrementally with openpyxl/xmlfile, not a multi-gigabyte scalar passed to a custom callback. No custom output callback API is exposed.

rows.precondition: XInclude processing fails to propagate parseFlags to an included resource loader.
rows.justification: Neither openpyxl nor renderer calls XInclude processing or supplies a custom external resource loader. XML_PARSE_NONET is not the sole defense: the affected operation is absent from the supported input path, and DOCX resources are pinned/local.
